title: Princeton AI Launches AI Alignment and Safety Research Initiative
summary:
A new technical program at Princeton University is focused on creating safeguards for artificial intelligence as the technology becomes more autonomous. Known as the AI Alignment and Safety initiative, the research group will develop technical solutions to ensure that increasingly capable AI systems remain safe for humans and aligned with human goals.

The program was introduced on October 19 at a launch event featuring speakers Boaz Barak, Adam Fungi, Ben Van Roy, Helen Qu, and Surbhi Goel. The effort is led by Princeton AI and includes contributions from researchers such as Prateek Mittal and Peter Henderson.
